method: Two measurements per variant with one fixed legacy/200 harness and receiver. Reference source is read from the pinned commit and compiled at 1000 runs; the working source is compiled at 500. Forge uses --isolate with identical deployment addresses and signed calldata. Independent Anvil receipts use identical inputs, timestamps, starting state and fixed wallet bytecode. Read-call execution gas is compared separately from successful and reverted transaction receipts.

receipts.method: Actual Prague transaction receipts with a fixed 16M gas limit and 2 gwei gas price, without estimates. Identical addresses, calldata, timestamps, signatures and application state across variants. Each scenario resets to its starting snapshot; complete input/event traces and final state match. Sender ETH balances are excluded because gas costs intentionally differ.
